Life GroupsLife is better together!12-week trimesters · In person & onlineOriginal Life Groups campaign artwork

Find your peopleWhatever yourstage of life.Life Groups meet in 12-week trimesters throughout the year where we can engage with one another, build intentional connections, and create friendships and belonging. Groups meet at varying times and in varying demographics, from general (open to anyone) to more specific, like new parents. Whatever your age or stage of life, there is a place for you. To better serve you, we meet using a hybrid model where some groups meet online while others may meet in person.Experience life groups!REGISTER HERE

Find a Group that Best Fits Your Life and Schedule:generalFor young and old, single or married, in college or a parent, any age and stage of life is welcome in our General groups.womenA women-only group where ladies of any age and stage of life are invited to enjoy sisterhood camaraderie.menBecome stronger men. Focus on the betterment as individuals, and as the spiritual head of your families and marriages.young adultsFor young adults ages 18-25 to grow and connect with others of similar age and stage of life.new parentsNew to parenthood? Connect with like-minded, first-time parents, glean fro
